acceptanceCriteria.text: Six clear transparent drill poses preserve mascot identity and include visible changing sparks; alpha bounds and anchors are documented.

tickets.body: Create a transparent six-frame drill animation matching the existing red/brass chibi mascot. His feet stay supported on a ticket top, drill angled downward into that surface, with short warm sparks at contact, excited recoil and body jiggle. Preserve original six assets. Use built-in imagegen and inspect the reference first. Own atlas.json, drill.png, sprite.ts, MascotSprite.tsx, sprite tests, animation gallery and asset documentation only. Shared contract: MascotSprite accepts motion: MotionState & { working?: boolean }; true selects a separate drill clip, false preserves existing action. Sprite helpers may accept MotionAction | 'drill'; do not edit motion.ts. Asset fps/anchors and sparks must remain within cell bounds and mirror correctly. Time all visible animation with existing playback, no independent uncontrolled CSS animation. Run targeted sprite tests and lint; full gate belongs to acceptance.

tickets.title: Animate the mascot using a little drill with sparks

acceptanceCriteria.text: Seeded tests show substantially more visits to reachable in-progress tickets than identical inactive tickets and verify bounded supported work sessions.
A new shake event interrupts drilling or movement once, visibly falls to the floor, recovers, and remains inside finite viewport bounds.
Detector tests distinguish rapid reversals from gentle panning, zoom, fit/programmatic moves, isolated moves, and repeated shaking within cooldown.
Status changes and moved/removed/unreachable tickets end stale work safely; existing locomotion tests continue to pass.

tickets.body: Extend pure motion and add a pure timestamped shake detector. Own motion.ts, its tests, new shake helper/tests only. Shared contract: MotionRect.inProgress?: boolean carries semantic active status. MotionState.working?: boolean marks a stationary drill session supported on an in-progress ticket; keep MotionAction's six existing values for compatibility with independent art. MotionSurfaces.shakeId?: number is a monotonically increasing event id consumed once; store consumption internally in MotionState. Prefer reachable active tickets strongly over ordinary tickets without suppressing all roaming, enter a bounded drill session after landing/climbing; promptly stop work if status changes or support disappears. Update supporting/target geometry appropriately for normal pans so gentle movement does not look like shake. On a new shake event interrupt work/locomotion, visibly stumble then fall to viewport floor, recover and resume, bounded and finite for resize/invalid geometry. Pure detector accepts user-pan samples and ignores programmatic moves and zoom, requires fast meaningful back-and-forth reversals, has cooldown; documented thresholds. TDD first; statistical/deterministic tests compare same seeds active vs inactive and test real short-plan reach, both sides, removal/status changes, fall continuity and cooldown. No DOM integration, no sprite files. Targeted tests plus lint only.

tickets.body: Integrate accepted art and motion contracts in the real PlanGraph. Own graph model/status propagation, geometry, GraphMascot, PlanGraph event plumbing, CSS if necessary, component tests, graph preview and behavior docs. Explicit semantic inProgress maps run ticket state running (not selected active) or lifecycle in_progress when no run; draft false. Feed only actual user panning into shake detector via React Flow move callbacks; programmatic fit and zoom do not trigger. Propagate shakeId once; no pending shake replay after pause/reduced-motion/hidden state. User graph controls remain unchanged and decorative pointer-events:none. Preserve RAF cleanup, persisted pause, reduced static idle, no new domain writes. Preview must show real active task state, observable drill and sparks, actual back-and-forth pan triggering fall, gentle pan not triggering fall, task completion stopping drill, existing selection/drag/pan/zoom. TDD tests first for logic and components. Run targeted tests/lint/typecheck; provide screenshots and browser observations. Full gate runs at acceptance.
